class.name: OcgShapebuildVertex
class.brief_description: Provides low-level functions used for constructing vertices
class.description: ! Provides low-level functions used for constructing vertices

method.name: CombineVertex_1
method.description: Combines new vertex from two others. This new one is the smallest vertex which comprises both of the source vertices. The function takes into account the positions and tolerances of the source vertices. The tolerance of the new vertex will be equal to the minimal tolerance that is required to comprise source vertices multiplied by tolFactor (in order to avoid errors because of discreteness of calculations).

method.name: CombineVertex_2
method.description: The same function as above, except that it accepts two points and two tolerances instead of vertices
